newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares gain on ITC bonus hopes.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares gain on ITC bonus hopes.

text.p: Delhi shares opened higher on Tuesday as foreign investors and speculators made hectic purchases on expectations that cigarette maker ITC might announce a bonus issue, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's sensitive index was up 1.81 points at 792.19 after the first 30 minutes of trade.
Brokers said ITC might announce a bonus shares issue.
"Foreign investors indulged in building substantial positions on expectations that ITC shares would to be auctioned at higher prices," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria Investments.
Reliance Industries quoted 0.50 rupee up at 304.75.
State Bank of India rose 1.20 rupees to 316.20.
Larsen and Toubro quoted 0.55 rupee higher at 214.75.
